sharpness: mean squared horizontal and vertical luminance first differences; ON/OFF ratio in same ROI/frame
focus_gate: focused ROI retains >= 0.70 of OFF edge energy; defocused ROI <= 0.90; evaluate near@30, middle@75, far@149; report all ratios
alpha: asset has zero and fractional alpha; composed output opaque with background; no claim of edge-bleed PASS from these alone
visual_approval: human full-video review is mandatory and cannot be automated
